title: The return of the thatcher
text: In many parts of rural England, the craft of thatching was close to [[1]] by the middle of the twentieth century. Cheap tiles had made straw roofs seem [[2]] as well as old-fashioned, and few young people were willing to commit to an [[3]] lasting several years. Recently, however, the trade has enjoyed an [[4]] revival. Part of the appeal lies in the [[5]] of a well-made roof, which can last for decades with only [[6]] repairs. Environmental concerns play a role too: straw and reed are [[7]] materials, and producing them requires [[8]] little energy.

explanation.en: 'Close to' is followed here by a noun: 'close to extinction' means almost disappearing completely.
explanation.cs: Po 'close to' (na pokraji) zde stojí podstatné jméno: extinction = vymření, zánik.

explanation.en: 'Seem' takes an adjective, and 'as well as old-fashioned' shows another negative quality: 'impractical'. 'Unpractical' exists too but is much less common.
explanation.cs: Po 'seem' následuje přídavné jméno se záporným významem (vedle 'old-fashioned'): impractical = nepraktický. Dvě změny: předpona im- a přípona -al.

explanation.en: Something 'lasting several years' is a period of training, not a person, so the noun is 'apprenticeship'.
explanation.cs: 'Lasting several years' popisuje období, ne osobu: apprentice = učeň, apprenticeship = učení, vyučení se.

explanation.en: 'However' contrasts the revival with the earlier decline, so nobody expected it: 'an unexpected revival'. Two changes: the prefix un- and the -ed ending.
explanation.cs: 'However' staví oživení do kontrastu s předchozím úpadkem, takže je nečekané: un- + expect + -ed = unexpected.

explanation.en: After 'the' and before 'of' a noun is needed, and 'can last for decades' points to the meaning: 'durability'.
explanation.cs: Mezi 'the' a 'of' patří podstatné jméno. Střecha vydrží desítky let: durability = trvanlivost (-able se mění na -ability).

explanation.en: An adjective describes the noun 'repairs': 'only occasional repairs' means repairs from time to time.
In the context of environmental concerns, materials that can be grown again are 'renewable'. 'Renewed' fits the grammar but not the meaning.
explanation.cs: Ekologický kontext: obnovitelné materiály = renewable materials. Renewed (obnovený) významově nesedí.

explanation.en: An adverb modifies 'little': 'comparatively little energy' means little in comparison with other materials. Two steps: compare, comparative, comparatively.
explanation.cs: Příslovce před 'little': comparatively = poměrně, ve srovnání. Dva kroky: compare, comparative, comparatively.
